jd.title: Data Analyst
jd.raw_text:
Data Analyst — DataBridge Technologies, Hyderabad

We are looking for an entry-level Data Analyst to support reporting and insights for our clients.

Responsibilities:
- Write SQL queries to extract and aggregate data
- Build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau
- Analyze datasets using Python (pandas, numpy)
- Present findings with clear data visualization

Required skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI or Tableau, Python, pandas, statistics, data visualization.
Nice to have: ETL, data warehousing, cloud (Azure or GCP), stakeholder communication.

Eligibility: B.Sc / B.Com / BCA freshers with strong analytical skills.
